correctness.rationale: For quartic X^4+Y^4+XZ^3, the three partial derivatives have no common nonzero projective zero for p>=5. Separating vertical lines X=lambda Z gives four hyperflex bitangents; Y=mX+cZ with c!=0 yields exactly k=(-3±sqrt3)/12 and two equations c^12=a±^3 with 12 roots each (no repetitions, p>=5), total 28. Independent symbolic irreducibility checks for P8=48U^8-24U^4-1 and P16=2304U^16+1152U^12+624U^8-24U^4+1 support orbit partition 1,1,2,8,16. The nonsquare norm a+a-=-1/48 over Q(i) implies quartic Kummer degree four over Q(i,sqrt3), so common Galois splitting field has degree16. Direct finite-field perfect-square tests independently corroborated exact N_p=2/4/28 residue/fourth-power cases for sampled primes through 97; the unrestricted statement uses the algebraic factorization and Chebotarev density, not samples.
